seedMethod: pinned crypto entropy; normal Begin button

item.name: Warden's Baton
item.description: Standard issue for Elias. Boosts attack and defense.

item.name: Warden's Emblem
item.description: Badge of authority that steadies resolve.

item.name: Medical Kit
item.description: Emergency medical supplies. Restores 15 HP to one character.

rooms.purpose: Orient at the transfer threshold
rooms.formerUse: Receive sealed admissions records
rooms.humanTrace: A delivery trolley waits beneath a cancelled shift plate
rooms.focalPoint: ARCHIVE transfer lintel

rooms.purpose: Read the absent index and release the evidence seal
rooms.formerUse: Authorize retrieval and record every access
rooms.humanTrace: A clean rectangle replaces a numbered drawer
rooms.focalPoint: Indexing machine with a blank index band

rooms.purpose: Compress the route between tall ranks of records
rooms.formerUse: Store active case files on mobile enamel racks
rooms.humanTrace: One pull handle is polished by repeated use
rooms.focalPoint: A narrow amber passage between filing ribs

rooms.purpose: Reveal institutional scale before returning to a human trace
rooms.formerUse: Sort and stage whole years of records
rooms.humanTrace: The last returned folder remains outside its drawer
rooms.focalPoint: Long numbered filing ranks

rooms.purpose: Establish the missing segment as the return landmark
rooms.formerUse: Mechanically reconcile conflicting versions of one record
rooms.humanTrace: An entire segment was removed with deliberate precision
rooms.focalPoint: An open records drum with one missing segment

rooms.purpose: Confront the existing Riot Recording
rooms.formerUse: Listen to and copy authorized evidence
rooms.humanTrace: An interrupted transcription curls from the retrieval desk
rooms.focalPoint: Tape reader beneath an isolated task lamp

rooms.purpose: Reward return with a finite evidence cache
rooms.formerUse: Hold originals behind an indexed access seal
rooms.humanTrace: Unaltered files remain visible through the service aperture
rooms.focalPoint: Secure evidence cage and sealed drawers

rooms.purpose: Confront the established Broken Floor rescue choice
rooms.formerUse: Carry overflowing storage into the service stack
rooms.humanTrace: A retrieval strap is fixed to the surviving floor edge
rooms.focalPoint: Interrupted filing rail above a fractured floor

rooms.purpose: Prepare for the existing Archive guardian and descend
rooms.formerUse: Transfer sealed records to the Ward
rooms.humanTrace: A final routing slip bears no recipient
rooms.focalPoint: WARD transfer door and descent

rooms.purpose: Reward careful navigation with a recoverable supply cache
rooms.formerUse: Maintain indexing machinery from behind the public walls
rooms.humanTrace: A worker hid medical supplies behind the removed-files shelf
rooms.focalPoint: A maintenance drawer left fractionally open

state.explorationNotice: Transfer sealed records to the Ward. A final routing slip bears no recipient.

world.timingScope: real RAF intervals and CPU render submission; initial 45-frame warmup, explicit reset starts a full window; maximum 4096 samples; GPU timer not sampled
